_comment: Declarative registry of Hyly's BigQuery tables (ADR 0022).
Adding a future Hyly table should mean adding an entry here plus a rollup
SQL file — not editing hyly_client.py and shipping a Flask deploy.
tests/test_hyly_contract.py asserts every entry below still exists with the
declared columns, so vendor drift surfaces as a failing test rather than as
'access' records what the rpm-portal service account can actually reach as
of 2026-08-17 — 'granted' or 'blocked'. Blocked entries are skipped by the
contract test with a warning instead of failing the suite.

sources.name: ga_hyly_mti
sources.grain: one row per (contact, event); milestone timestamps denormalised onto every row

sources.name: ga4_analytics_events
sources.grain: standard GA4 export enriched with Hyly org/property ids
sources.notes: 10.19 GB. NOT yet ingested. This is where visitors / known_visitors / UTM detail live; ingesting it is what restores the visitor half of the ADR 0015 contract. Never scan on a page load.
